comparison.objective: Choose labeled standard weights that make a scale read exactly 300 g.
comparison.physical_skill: Reads labels and places a correct arithmetic combination on a pan; no fine adjustment mechanism or physical feedback loop is manipulated.
comparison.success_condition: Final resting mass is scored as 300 g, partial at 200 or 400 g, otherwise zero.
comparison.reason: This tests semantic selection and discrete mass composition, not iterative mechanical tuning despite both involving a measured outcome.
